name: Iron Foundations
description: The first forging. Three full-body days that build the base every warrior stands on.

name: Push Pull Legs
description: The classic war rhythm: push the enemy back, pull them down, stand your ground.

name: Warrior's Arm Forge
description: Specialization block. Hammer the arms from every angle until the sleeves surrender.

name: Leg Day Legion
description: March or fall. Three lower-body sieges for quads, hamstrings, and glutes.

name: Core of Steel
description: The keep at the center of the castle. Armor the trunk that holds everything up.

name: Upper Lower Split
description: Four days, two fronts. Alternate the upper and lower kingdoms all week.

name: Bodyweight Battalion
description: No iron, no excuses. Wage the campaign anywhere with your own weight.

name: Dumbbell Crusade
description: One pair of dumbbells, an entire arsenal. Full campaign with minimal gear.

name: Strength of the Ancients
description: The old lifts, the old ways. Five heavy sets of five on the great barbell lifts.

name: The Gauntlet
description: Five days, five trials. One body part per day — the classic warrior split.

name: ⚡ Arms Onslaught
